ring.$description: Focus ring color for all interactive elements

ring-offset.$description: Inner gap color for dual-layer focus rings

text.$description: Accent text color (active tabs, links, highlights)

hover.$description: Dark-mode primary hover — steps two shades brighter (600 was too close to 500 to be visible).

intense.$description: Bright white overlay for track rings and decorative accents on colored surfaces

solid.$description: Near-opaque white used as foreground on colored surfaces (e.g. spinners on buttons)

backdrop.$description: Default backdrop blur for modal and overlay dialogs

color.$description: Easing for color and opacity transitions

1.$description: Subtle resting elevation for cards and inputs

2.$description: Raised elevation for hover states and tooltips

3.$description: Floating elevation for dropdowns and popovers

5.$description: Top-level elevation for drawers and command palette
